title: Microsoft open-sources “the earliest DOS source code discovered to date”
summary: Microsoft has open-sourced the earliest known DOS (Disk Operating System) source code discovered to date, making historical computing artifacts publicly available for study and preservation. This release provides developers and tech historians unprecedented access to the foundational code that powered early personal computers.
problem_solved: Preserves computing history and provides access to early operating system source code for educational and research purposes.
why_valuable: Offers rare insight into the origins of personal computing software and enables developers to study foundational operating system design from the early PC era.
